name: Steel Browser API for AI Agents (Token-Protected)
description: Self-hosted Steel headless browser API for AI agents, behind a token.

STEEL_API_TOKEN.description: Access token, generated at deploy. Send it as Authorization: Bearer, steel-api-key header, ?token= / ?apiKey=, or as the web UI password (user steel).

PORT.description: Port of the token gateway (public domain and healthcheck). Steel itself listens on 127.0.0.1:3000 only.

DOMAIN.description: Public host name Steel puts into session URLs (websocketUrl, debugUrl). Change it when you add a custom domain.

USE_SSL.description: Session URLs use https:// and wss:// (Railway terminates TLS).

CHROME_HEADLESS.description: Run Chromium headless. The live session viewer works in headless mode too.

LOG_STORAGE_ENABLED.description: Keep session event logs in DuckDB on the /data volume (shown in the web UI).

LOG_STORAGE_MAX_MB.description: At start, a session event log larger than this (MB) is replaced by a new one, so the volume never fills. 0 = no limit.

PROXY_URL.description: Optional outbound proxy you are allowed to use for all sessions, e.g. http://user:pass@host:8080.

STEEL_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for steel-sdk (baseURL) and the REST API. Reference it from other services.

STEEL_WS_ENDPOINT.description: CDP WebSocket URL with the token for Puppeteer browserWSEndpoint / Playwright connectOverCDP.
